name: Non-operational P rotation
description: Reference condition used by the 4HK1 TM scan-tool data list; values vary with actual machine condition.

name: Two Pump Relief
description: Reference condition used by the 4HK1 TM scan-tool data list; values vary with actual unit conditions.

name: Engine overheat
description: Normal overheat context for P0217 threshold.

name: DPD regeneration
description: DPD regeneration context changes the P0217 coolant-temperature threshold.

name: Idle vibration control
description: Cylinder compensation is evaluated from crank-speed variation; normal correction range is ±5 mm3.

name: Engine warm-up control
description: Warm-up switch enabled, engine running, accelerator not depressed, vehicle stationary, coolant approximately 70 °C or below; desired idle rises up to 1100 rpm.

name: Pre-glow phase
description: Glow relay applies voltage 0.5–17 s depending on coolant temperature; 0.5 s when coolant is 20 °C or higher.

name: After-glow phase
description: Glow relay applies voltage 0.5–18 s depending on coolant temperature; 0.5 s when coolant is 10 °C or higher.
